purpose: Collect the read-only diagnostic picture of the customer's PC - the fixed inspection the whole run is grounded on. Deterministic by design: the collectors are settled code, not a model decision (inspection-is-deterministic-not-model), so the count is one honest number - exactly 25 Section collectors in StoreApp/Diagnostics.cs (os..battery), presented to the customer as six headline areas (system, storage & disk health, security, network, performance, overall integrity). It only READS; nothing on the PC is changed. Its output is the referent every later sign is bound to: the model explains and relates these observations, it never invents them.

capabilities.name: collect
capabilities.function: Run 25 read-only Section collectors (os, uptime, cpu, memory, disk, smart_health, temp_files, browser_caches, recycle_bin, windows_update_cache, delivery_optimization, dns_cache, network, startup, power, battery, ... ) into one $diag dictionary. No system change.

capabilities.name: six_headline_areas
capabilities.function: The 25 collectors present to the customer as six areas: system, storage & disk health, security, network, performance, overall integrity.

capabilities.name: audit_gate
capabilities.function: A completed Collect() is validated by StoreApp/SystemAudit.cs (SystemAuditor.Assess -> SystemAudit.IsValid + EvidenceHash): only a valid, completed audit may reach the model / plan / consent / repair.

demonstration.input_fixture: none - reads the live machine (no input); the downstream envelope is exercised by pod/fixtures/eval.json
expected_outputs: a $diag dictionary with exactly 25 top-level collector sections
every value is observed telemetry, never a model-authored fact
a SystemAudit that reports IsValid + a stable EvidenceHash over the completed scan
observable_events: SystemAudit completed + validated (25/25 sections) - asserted in tests/ModelSmoke
the EvidenceHash that binds the findings relay record (TOTEM-C-0112)

evidence.source: Placed from StoreApp/Diagnostics.cs (25 Section collectors, verified count) + StoreApp/SystemAudit.cs (the completeness gate). Closes the C-0119 gap where this Orb dir was empty and its umbilical reference dangled. trust_state=provisional matches the manifest attachment.
